info.name: Polymath API Service CANBus Vehicle Autonomy API
Get the combined Autonomy, Navigation and Vehicle feedback from the Polymath system

items.docs: Returns combined autonomy, navigation, and vehicle feedback from the Polymath system.
Returns the latest latitude/longitude coordinates for the four corners of the global costmap boundary.

info.name: Get the available Navigation Path Options and associated Parameters

items.docs: Returns available navigation path options and configurable parameters.
Returns available motion commands that can be sent to the Polymath system.

info.name: Get all previously set reference targets

items.docs: Returns all previously set reference targets.

info.name: Set the location and details of a reference location or an object

items.docs: Sets one or more reference targets for relative navigation. Each target may include optional `time_validity` and `recorded_speed_m_s` metadata. Use `POST /relative-waypoints` to send waypoints relative to these targets.

info.name: Set a reference target at the current robot location

items.docs: Creates a `previous_location` reference target from the robot's current GPS pose for subsequent relative navigation.

info.name: Send a set of gps waypoints to the robot

items.docs: Sends GPS waypoints and navigation options to the robot.

info.name: Send a set of relative waypoints to the robot

items.docs: Sends relative waypoints and navigation options to the robot.

info.name: Send a motion command to the robot to change its current state

items.docs: Sends a motion command to change the robot motion state. Supported commands: `STOP` (0), `PAUSE` (1), and `RESUME` (2).
